name: keep_or_move_date
description: With 400 a month the upfront cost (4,430) comes from a module and then feeds the months module; keeping or moving the date is the person's call, and they answer in their own words.
lines: If I can only put aside 400 a month, how long until I can pay for the move? The deposit is 1,200 and the van hire is 380. I will pay three months of overlapping rent at 950 a month, and I have no other costs. I have saved 1,000 so far, not counting my emergency fund, and the move is in 7 months. Then help me decide whether to keep the move date or move it.
I would rather keep the date and find a way to save more each month.
